mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) reduce discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as capital flows into equities during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 8.0% signal deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 40% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%, or correlation between UNRATE and SPX 20d returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP growth (GDPC1 < 18000) and housing starts (HOUST < 1500) indicate aggregate demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 50% of periods when both GDPC1 < 18000 and HOUST < 1500, or joint signal Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly CPIAUCSL inflation exceeding 3% (m/m change > 0.03) triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL m/m change > 0.03, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL m/m change is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (INDPRO > 100) indicates robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC for INDPRO is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth below 140,000 (PAYEMS < 140000) signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 40% of periods when PAYEMS < 140000, or correlation between PAYEMS and SPX 5d returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in retail sales (RSAFS < 520000) and housing starts (HOUST < 1500) reflect weakening consumer demand, driving equity market declines and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 50% of periods when both RSAFS < 520000 and HOUST < 1500, or joint signal Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95 (INDPRO < 95) indicates manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate profitability expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 40% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC for INDPRO is below 0.02.
